Commentary.Commentary: THE MATCH HAS BEEN ABANDONED WITHOUT EVEN THE TOSS. Not a surprising decision, as it was raining heavily since last evening. The ground had turned into a swimming pool and for a game which is not the most relevant, does not make sense to play with the players' safety. Pakistan finish third while New Zealand fourth owing to their standings in the group stage. So that leaves us with only one game left. The final. Hopefully, India vs Bangladesh is a full game and a cracker. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!
